book.title: MAK Kamambuno wakai Mak muno boglkwa

content: Yagl ta ongo kagle mau sungwa Yesus erewakai orkwa
Ande enge tau endongo okuwo, Yesus aglke ende ikine Kaperneam kamun ongwa. Ye ende yungugl ongwa i ana ka wai dungo yomba pirkwa.
Yeglpre, yomba merkinde wu igle makai singo ama yungugl angai sitndungo te mendakra yungu dramugl pra meglko ana Yesus kamambuno dipene ende tongwa.
Enge i yomba tau wingo ana yagl 4 eremogl, yagl ta ongo kagle mau sungwa bagl yombugl iyu Yesus moglmara wingwa.
Ana yomba merkinde kau-kau eriko, ye kinde sungwa yagle iyu Yesus moglmara enaglkwa mere mango, ye Yesus moglmara yungu tembe i indaun terke ende kenge gundo endingwa audi yongo,
ana yagle gagle mina pai moglko ende atne endingwa.
Ye pirngi dingwa Yesus kandre, ye ongo kagle mau sungwa yagle ditongwa, “Wana yagle, ene tandaglmen prapra koko endiga.”
Enge igle, lo beke teingwa yomba tau igle amedi meglkwa, yene nomano wagle yegl pirkwa,
“Sraglpre yagl i ka yegl dume? Ye God kenaglmo sungwa! Yomba tandaglme ta koko endekraglkwa, ba God suwara koko endinambuka.”
Yomba nomano mina poglodi pirkwa i Yesus oglandi kandre ana ye ditongwa, “Sraglpre ene taragl i poglodi pirme?
Sragl ka undungwa ditenagle, ‘Ene tandaglmen i prapra dundume dinaglo’ mo ‘Andigl kungutn indre, ana konbo ende po’ dinaglka i undume?
Ba i ene kanaglkwa. Yomba Wam ye yombuglo kande pangwa pre, makandle tandaglmeno prapra koko ende tenambuka.” Ana ye ongo kagle mau sungwa yagle ditongwa,
“Na ene diteinga, ene andigl kungutn indre ende yungun po.”
Ana ye andigl kunguglmo indre ana yomba prapra ongumutno-mugl konbo endongwa. Ye prapra i kan sipuglo kinde di ana ye God dembiye sindre dingwa, “Nono okuna taragl yeglmere ta kankunga!”
Yesus eremogl Levai agle dungwa
Yesus aglke kordagl ende ikine Galili Niglmong bina ongwa. Ana yomba merkinde ye moglmara wingo ana ye God kamo beke tongwa.
Ana ye konbo ende pindre kangwa, Levai,
ye Alfias wam yene takis yumara yungu yungugl amedi moglko ana Yesus ditongwa, “Na mokonamugl wo.” Ana Levai andigl ye omara mokomugl endongwa.
Okuwo pokndungo Yesus ye takis ingwa yomba ya te tandaglme erikwa yomba, ye disaipelma bogl wu suwara pi Levai yungumugl kaiya mokna neingwa. Yeglpre yomba merkinde ye omara mokomugl eingwa.

Lo beke teingwa yomba tau ye Parisi wagle bogl kaningo Yesus tandaglme erikwa yomba ya takis ingwa yomba bogl mogl kaiya mokna akiye neingwa. Ana Parisi wagle krapogl Yesus disaipelmo wagle teingwa, “Sraglpre ye takis ingwa yomba ya tandaglme erikwa yomba bogl akiye kaiya mokna neme?”

Yesus ka dingwa i pirtre ana di ikine ende tongwa, “Yomba kinde sikrukwa ye dokta moglmara ta pikrikwa, ba kinde sungwa yomba i keunde eingwa. Na yomba du-yene aglendi inagledi pre ta ukrika. Ba na tandaglme yomba pre winga.”
Yesus kaiya mokna mawagl erikwa pre krapogl teingwa

Jon disaipelmo ya Parisi wagle kaiya mokna mawagl meglkwa. Yomba tau undre ana krapogl Yesus teingwa, “Sragl mambuno pango Jon disaipelmo wagle ya Parisi nangro kaiya mokna mawagl erikwa. Ba ene disaipelnen mawagl erekrikwa?”

Ana Yesus yegl di ikine ende tongwa, “Ambu inambuka yagle ye digaglko wingwa yomba bogl akiye mogl panan kade, ye sraglpre kaiya mokna mawagl eraglme? Taman. Ye bogl akiye meglkwa pre ye yegl ta erekraglkwa.
Ba enge ta yenambuka enge, ambu inambuka yaglmo ye mina ikorugl endimbi, ana enge igle ye kaiya mokna mawagl moraglkwa.
“Yomba ta gagl alap kor kembra ta bagladi indre, gagl suna kande goglo mina simborambuka. Ye yegl eran, gagl kor simboglkwa i yombuglo ere gagl goglo si arglandi wu kande kaima enambuka.

Ana yomba ta wain kor toindi meme nangiye gagl goglo mina ta suna endekrambuka. Ye yegl eran ana wain nuglo meme nangiye sibagla dinan ana wain ya meme nangiye akiye kinde erambrika. Yeglpre, ye wain kor toindi meme nangiye kor mina atne endinambuka.”
Sabat pre krapeglkwa
Yesus Sabat enge ta wit yaglkwa moglmara ende suna ongwa. Ana ye disaipelma wagle omara akiye pindre, ye mambuno bogl wit mongo tau ake ditndi ingwa.
Yegl eriko, Parisi wagle Yesus diteingwa, “Pro, Sabat enge nono lono mane dumara ene disaipelnen sraglpre yegl erime?”
Yesus di Parisi wagle tongwa, “Okuna imbo Devit yombamo bogl kindan gogltre ana ye taragl ninaglkwa tamanga enge, ye taragl ta erikwa ikra ene kere pirkrimo?

Abiatar pris kande moglkwa enge, Devit eremogl God yungumo mina yungugl pindre ana bret God pre yei teingwa i nendre ana tau yombamo akiye waningwa tongwa. Ba bret i we pris wagle keunde ninaglkwa pre lo pangwa.”
Ana Yesus ditongwa, “Sabat yomba akeple dinambuka pre God ere yongwa. Yomba Sabat akeple dinambuka pre ta ere yeikrukwa.
Yeglpre Yomba Wam ye Sabat i nemyagl moglkwa.”

footnotes.text: Yungu i ira yungumo, nono pirpogl sikunga. Ba Yesus ende Kaperneam kamun ungwa enge ana ye yungumo i mina mogl mogl orkwa mere pangwa. Yomba tau Pita ya Andru yunguno wedi pirkwa. Mak 1:29 mina kano.
Juda yomba yunguno keingwa i bokis mereyegl ana tembe kra paglkane yongwa. Yungu yeglmere i yomba egli bogl kugl yei ende kuglo pipi erikwa.
Levai iwe, Matyu kangiye ta pangwa. Ana Matyu 9:9 mina kano.
